notes.title: Released my second game!
notes.notes:
I released my second game. 

Bustories: A Bus Travel Simulator.
A small visual novel about bus trips and conversation with different companions, whom you see for the first and last time in your life.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/778570/Bustories/

Thanks to your support, I was able to make the game that I wanted to do. I worked on this game for a year. I will be happy if you support me and buy it.

notes.title: About my plans, future of SAMOLIOTIK
notes.notes:
SAMOLIOTIK (from russian "little plane") was made as a joke during the development of my main project. Its just an experiment. Don't take it serious. Today will be available the Last Update for SAMOLIOTIK.  
   Now I will continue the development of my main game called Gravity Zero.
Gravity Zero is an old-school dynamic 2D top-down arcade combat racing game, inspired by Rock n Roll Racing, Carmageddon,and F-ZERO. There is no in-game upgrades, and the only important thing is your skills and abilities. This game is about impossible challenges, crazy races and hard bosses. During the race unpleasant behavior is acceptable: kill, destroy, demolish and crush your opponents. 
  You can follow me here:
[url=https://twitter.com/ItanimulliGames]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://vk.com/gravityzero]VK[/url]
[url=http://itanimulligames.com]Site[/url]
But don't worry, I will continue to support the group of SAMOLIOTIK, sometimes I will make free giveaways :D

notes.title: Fixing Steam Screenshots Issue
notes.notes:
There's an issue with Steam Screenshots right now, Screenshots save as TGA files and cannot be uploaded. This seems to happen with every game, But I thought it would be a good idea to share this.

Step 1: Going to Settings
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12199717/2179c010dfc4ecbd1410904a96ab150d189568a5.png[/img]
Step 2: Pressing the change button under "Steam Beta Update" and changing it to "Opt out of all beta programs"
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12199717/2cbd38e4cbf9232b4ac2375084b4d07c5b20135f.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12199717/3e9fa8e6b2e342be1f172770b9f2370530116181.png[/img]

This should've fixed the issue. If you are already opted out of the beta, You shouldn't have this issue.
